description: Transfer History. Calls only GET /v4/transfers and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching historical Token-2022 and SPL transfers by mint, sender, receiver, amount, and time range for analytics and whale tracking.

callingProgramAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields.

feePayerAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields.

limit.description: Limit of the number of transfers to return per page. Default/max is 1000.

maxAmount.description: Upper bound of the amount to filter with

minAmount.description: Lower bound of the amount to filter with

mintAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields.

receiverAccountAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields.

receiverAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields.

senderAccountAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields.

senderAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields.

sortByAsc.description: Sort ascending by 'amount', 'slot', or 'blockTime'. Only one of `sortByAsc` or `sortByDesc` can be used

sortByDesc.description: Sort descending by 'amount', 'slot', or 'blockTime'. Only one of `sortByAsc` or `sortByDesc` can be used

timeEnd.description: End time of the data to return (unix timestamp)

timeStart.description: Start time of the data to return (unix timestamp)

name: list-transfers
title: Transfer History
